ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda mass Chrome credential harvesting via GPO logon script
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's signature domain-wide credential theft: a PowerShell script (observed as IPScanner.ps1, driven by a logon.bat pushed through a modified/created Group Policy) that copies Chromium 'Login Data' SQLite stores off every endpoint at user logon. Sophos attributed this mass Chrome-stealer-via-GPO behaviour specifically to the Qilin RaaS affiliate in 2024 — it is highly atypical for ransomware crews and is a strong pre-encryption pivot.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default*" OR Processes.process="*IPScanner.ps1*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval gpo_vector=if(match(parent_process_name,"(?i)(gpscript|userinit|cmd)\.exe"),1,0)
| where NOT match(user,"\$$")
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data", @"\Google\Chrome\User Data", @"\Chrome\User Data\Default", "IPScanner.ps1")
   or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Copy-Item","copy ") and ProcessCommandLine has "Chrome")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend GpoVector = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","cmd.exe")   // logon-script delivery = Qilin GPO push
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, GpoVector, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Login Data", @"\Google\Chrome\User Data", @"\Chrome\User Data\Default", "IPScanner.ps1")
   or (CommandLine has_any ("Copy-Item","copy ") and CommandLine has "Chrome")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend GpoVector = ParentProcessName has_any ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","cmd.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, GpoVector
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda safe-mode reboot + shadow-copy destruction pre-encryption
ucs.description: Correlates the two-step detonation prep Qilin/Agenda runs on each host before T1486 encryption: forcing a Safe Mode boot via bcdedit (to neutralise EDR) combined with shadow-copy/backup-catalog deletion via vssadmin/wmic/wbadmin within the same hour. The Safe Mode reboot specifically to encrypt is a documented Qilin/Agenda behaviour and is rare for other crews.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe")) (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*delete systemstatebackup*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*") by Processes.dest _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(cmds,"(?i)safeboot") AND (match(cmds,"(?i)delete shadows") OR match(cmds,"(?i)shadowcopy delete") OR match(cmds,"(?i)delete catalog"))
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
   or (FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 50), Procs = make_set(FileName, 20), Start = min(Timestamp), End = max(Timestamp), User = any(AccountName)
         by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where Procs has "bcdedit.exe" and (Procs has "vssadmin.exe" or Procs has "wmic.exe" or Procs has "wbadmin.exe")   // safe-mode + recovery-kill combo = Qilin detonation prep
| order by Start desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
   or (NewProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 50), Procs = make_set(NewProcessName, 20), Start = min(TimeGenerated), User = any(SubjectUserName)
         by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where Procs has "bcdedit.exe" and (Procs has "vssadmin.exe" or Procs has "wmic.exe" or Procs has "wbadmin.exe")
| order by Start desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: bcdedit Safe Mode Boot Configuration (Qilin/Agenda Pre-Encryption)
id: 4f1c8b90-6e2d-49a7-9b3c-2d5f0a17e3c2
status: experimental
description: bcdedit forcing a Safe Mode boot, characteristic of Qilin/Agenda rebooting hosts to disable EDR before encrypting
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate OS recovery / boot troubleshooting by administrators
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *Safeboot* OR *"recoveryenabled no"*)) OR (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"delete catalog"*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(bcdedit|vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin)\.exe$/i
| (CommandLine=/safeboot/i OR CommandLine=/recoveryenabled\s+no/i OR CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i OR CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i OR CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine]))
| (CommandLine=/safeboot/i)
| (CommandLine=/(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|delete\s+catalog)/i)
ucs.rationale: Most ransomware deletes shadow copies (T1490) — that alone is not actor-specific. What distinguishes Qilin/Agenda is pairing a forced Safe Mode reboot (bcdedit /set safeboot) with recovery destruction in the same window to strip EDR before encrypting. Requiring both the bcdedit safeboot signal and shadow/backup deletion on the same host within an hour fingerprints the Qilin detonation sequence rat
